before.implementation: pre-ca75409f _db_upsert always updates an existing row

method_notes: The before image was built from the pre-optimization commit and run as an isolated container on port 8890 against the same PostgreSQL service.
The after image was the deployed current container on port 8889.
pg_stat_single_table_counters was reset before each 50-request run and read after a two-second stats flush.
The probe reads an existing completed workflow; it does not start or mutate a workflow's content.
The before container intentionally updates updated_at on each poll; this is the production-like cost being measured.

result.latency_claim: No material wall-clock latency improvement is claimed; the measured benefit is eliminated no-op DB writes and row locks.
